title: OpenClaw Scheduled Work
goal: Run recurring OpenClaw work with evidence, stop rules, and clear human handoff points
current_state: The recurring task exists, but it needs stronger state tracking and repeated-failure handling
constraints: Do not keep retrying the same failed verifier without rollback or human input
Do not publish, delete, or send external output without confirmation
verifiers: Each scheduled run reads previous reports.jsonl
Each run appends exactly one JSON report
Repeated verifier failures trigger rollback or needs_human

browser_verification: Only required when the scheduled task changes public pages
forbidden_areas: Do not change production schedules without human confirmation
harness.local_secrets: Do not read local credentials unless required by the scheduled task and approved.
cost_strategy: Use stronger models for loop redesign
Use cheaper models for scheduled readback and report formatting
